Read more A joint digitization project involving Latvia’s largest ports has been completed, resulting in a unified digital platform for the ports of Riga, Ventspils, and Liepāja. Designed to streamline operations and enhance customer service, this shared platform will improve collaboration, accelerate information flow, and reduce manual data entry, establishing a robust technological foundation for the future development of Latvia’s maritime sector. Read more Digital Transformation of Port Governance through Enhanced Processing and Analysis of Transport and Logistics Data 03.03.2025. Read more The objective of the project is to promote the digital transformation of port governance in Latvia by improving the processing and analysis of transport and logistics data through the implementation of an integrated, shared and adaptable platform. Read more Providing of safe berthing of Ro-Ro ferries in the port of Liepaja 19.12.2024. Read more The port of Liepaja lies on the coast of the Baltic Sea and by handling ~ 7 million tons per annum is a part of the comprehensive Trans - European transport (hereinafter in the text: TEN-T) network. Read more Elaboration of a Feasibility Study of the Development of the Historically Contaminated Sediment Disposal Site of the Port of Liepāja Karosta Canal 26.11.2024. Read more During the period from August 1 to October 31, 2024, the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority was implementing the initiative of the Bilateral Cooperation Fund of the Norwegian Financial Instrument 2014-2021 Programme “Climate Change Mitigation, Adaptation and Environment” “Elaboration of a Feasibility Study of the Development of the Historically Contaminated Sediment Disposal Site of the Port of Liepāja Karosta Canal” (hereinafter referred to as the Initiative). Read more 2023. - 2030. 09.02.2024. Read more The development areas of the Port of Liepaja are suitable for the development of the offshore wind energy industry - for the construction of a support base for wind farms, as well as for the production of individual parts and components. Read more Remediation of the historically polluted site at the Liepaja Port Karosta Canal 07.02.2024. Read more Remediation works on the Karosta Channel in the Port of Liepaja. Read more Liepaja Special Economic Zone Authority on 8 January 2024 signed contracts for the commencement of construction works for the project "Liepaja Industrial Park Territory Development Phase 1" 08.01.2024. Read more The project will include the reconstruction of the territory of the former factory "Liepājas metalurgs" in Liepāja between Brīvības Street, Meldru Street, Liepājas Lake, Ezermalas Street, Parka Street and Zemnieku Street with adjacent territories bordering Liepāja Lake, constructing public street infrastructure with utility networks, to provide basic business infrastructure, creating a functioning industrial park of national importance, ensuring the functionality of the developed area in accordance with the approved Liepaja Industrial Park Long-Term Development Strategy 2023. -2038. We offer: • An exciting job in a stable and well-established company; • Career development opportunities; • Support from colleagues during training and work processes; • Employee well-being benefits – a modern working environment, free gym access, holiday gifts, financial support for special life events, subsidized lunches, accident insurance (from the first day of employment), health insurance, and more; • Salary starting from EUR 1,000 gross, depending on skills and experience. We appreciate candidates who have: • The ability to perform physically demanding work for extended periods; • A high level of accuracy, punctuality, and work efficiency; • A positive and responsible attitude towards work; • Willingness to work according to a shift schedule; • A strong sense of responsibility and commitment to performing assigned tasks to a high standard. Work location: Virssardzes iela 11, Liepāja Send your CV to: cv@jensenmetal.eu We will contact candidates who are selected for the next stages of the recruitment process. By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data. EUR 1000 29995892 cv@jensenmetal.eu Procurement Specialist LSEZ "Jensen Metal" SIA Metalworking company LSEZ "Jensen Metal" SIA is offering a position for a Procurement Specialist. Responsibilities: • Ensure timely purchasing and ordering of materials according to production and company operational needs; • Place orders and negotiate with suppliers regarding prices, delivery terms, and purchasing contract conditions; • Compare prices, delivery times, technical specifications, and product compliance to make informed purchasing decisions; • Coordinate daily warehouse operations according to the manager's instructions, monitor task completion, organize and participate in inventory counts; • Cooperate with carriers, customs authorities, and company departments; • Resolve issues related to deliveries and product quality; • Maintain purchasing, material, and related documentation records in the ERP system. Requirements: • Experience in procurement or supply management; • Excellent Latvian and English language skills (working in an international environment); • Good communication and cooperation skills; • Ability to read technical drawings and determine the materials required for ordering; • Ability to quickly resolve unexpected situations. We offer: • An exciting job in a stable and well-established company; • A modern working environment and working conditions, free access to the company gym, holiday gifts, financial benefits, subsidized lunches, accident and health insurance, and more; • Salary starting from EUR 2,000 gross or more, depending on skills and experience. From EUR 1900 26031056 cv@jensenmetal.eu Design Engineer "RT Metāls" SIA LSEZ We are looking for a DESIGN ENGINEER to join our team. We are seeking a motivated and energetic specialist who is eager to take on new challenges, develop their skills, and grow together with the company. If you have analytical thinking skills, attention to detail, and an interest in technical solutions, we would be happy to meet you! Candidate Requirements: • Previous experience and knowledge in engineering design and drafting are required; • Proficiency in CAD software (Inventor, Advance Steel, Revit, and AutoCAD) will be considered an advantage; • English language skills are required for communication and understanding technical documentation; • A responsible attitude towards work and a willingness to develop professionally. We offer: • Salary starting from EUR 1,800 gross (depending on experience and qualifications); • Employment in a stable, export-oriented manufacturing company; • Professional development and training opportunities; • Competitive remuneration based on performance and contribution; • Health insurance; • Team-building events and a friendly working environment; • Paid sports activities (swimming pool and padel tennis). Work location: Laboratorijas iela 20, Liepāja Working hours: Full-time Please send your CV to: cv@rtmetals.lv Learn more about us: www.facebook.com/rtmetals or www.rtmetals.lv EUR 1800 cv@rtmetals.lv Finishing Works Worker SIA “VIA-S modular houses” Due to increasing workloads, SIA “VIA-S modular houses” is looking for a Finishing Works Worker to join our team. Responsibilities: • Interior and exterior finishing work on modular houses; • Preparation and finishing of walls, ceilings, and floors; • Filling, painting, and other related tasks; • Various installation and assembly tasks; • Completing work in accordance with quality standards and established deadlines; • Maintaining order and complying with workplace safety requirements. We are looking for candidates who have: • Experience in interior and exterior finishing work; • Ability to work with various construction tools; • Ability to independently complete assigned tasks to a high standard; • A responsible attitude towards work and a willingness to improve their skills and knowledge. We offer: • Stable full-time employment; • An opportunity to work in a growing and developing company; • Supportive colleagues and a positive working environment; • Salary of EUR 1,200 gross. Work location: Oskara Kalpaka iela 40A, Liepāja Please send your application and CV to: via-s@via-s.lv By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data. title: Electronic Ascending-Bid Auction of Part of the Property at Brīvības Street 94 (Auction Completed)
text: Contact Person Raivo Špaks Biznesa attīstības departamenta vadītājs Phone: (+371) 29294267 Email: raivo.spaks@lsez.lv 09. October, 2025 Electronic Ascending-Bid Auction of Part of the Property at Brīvības Street 94 (Auction Completed) Results of the property auction: On 12 September 2025, the electronic auction organised by the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority for part of the property at Brīvības Street 94, Liepāja, concluded. The highest bid of EUR 378,750.00 (three hundred and seventy-eight thousand seven hundred and fifty euros), excluding value added tax, was made by SIA “Nordic Steel Latvia” , registration No. 40203671003, registered address: Krišjāņa Valdemāra Street 33-3F, Riga, LV-1010. The auction results were approved at the LSEZ Board meeting on 8 October 2025, Board Decision No. 103. _____________________________________ The Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority, unified registration No. LV90000329402, is holding an electronic ascending-bid auction for part of the property at Brīvības Street 94, Liepāja, cadastral designation 17000220059. The property includes buildings with cadastral designations 17000220059089 and 17000220059090, and parts of a land plot with a total area of approximately 21,778 m 2 (the area will be specified after surveying is completed). The starting price is EUR 375,000.00 (three hundred and seventy-five thousand euros), the bid increment is EUR 3,750.00 (three thousand seven hundred and fifty euros), and the auction security deposit is EUR 37,500.00 (thirty-seven thousand five hundred euros). The purchase price is payable as follows: Within 10 working days after the preliminary agreement enters into force, the purchaser pays an advance of 30% (thirty percent) of the purchase price. The purchaser pays the remaining purchase price within two weeks after the purchase agreement is signed. The auction starts on 12 August 2025 at 13:00 and ends on 11 September 2025 at 13:00 . Prospective bidders may register from 12 August 2025 at 13:00 until 1 September 2025 at 23:59 on the electronic auction website https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . Anyone wishing to participate must pay a security deposit of 10% (ten percent) of the property's starting price, namely EUR 37,500.00 (thirty-seven thousand five hundred euros), by the registration deadline. The amount must be transferred to the LSEZ Authority account: Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority, unified registration No. LV90000329402, AS “SEB banka”, account No. LV42UNLA0012000609480 , with payment reference “Security deposit for the auction of the property at Brīvības Street 94”. The auction is conducted electronically at https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . For information about the property auction, call 29294267 or email raivo.spaks@lsez.lv . Pielikumi 12. title: Electronic Ascending-Bid Auction of 130 Shock-Absorbing Fender Units
text: Contact person Linda Saltone Phone: +371 29109677 Email: linda.saltone@lsez.lv 29. August, 2024 Electronic Ascending-Bid Auction of 130 Shock-Absorbing Fender Units The Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority is organising an electronic ascending-bid auction for the disposal of its movable property: a total of 130 shock-absorbing fenders. The goods are offered in four lots: three lots of 40 (forty) fenders each and one lot of 10 (ten) fenders. Individual fenders will not be sold separately. Starting price (reserve price): One lot of 40 (forty) fenders: EUR 4,800.00 (four thousand eight hundred euros). One lot of 10 (ten) fenders: EUR 1,200.00 (one thousand two hundred euros). Bid increment: One lot of 40 (forty) fenders: EUR 150.00 (one hundred and fifty euros). One lot of 10 (ten) fenders: EUR 40.00 (forty euros). Value added tax will be applied to the auction price. The auction security deposit amounts to 10% of the starting price of each lot (EUR 480.00 for a lot of 40 fenders and EUR 120.00 for a lot of 10 fenders). Within 20 (twenty) days from the auction start date, anyone wishing to participate must transfer the deposit to the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority, registration No. 90000329402, AS “Swedbank”, account No. LV12HABA0001407037000, with the payment reference “Security deposit for fender auction”, and submit an application for authorisation to participate via https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . The auction takes place on the electronic auction website https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . The auction opens on 9 September 2024 at 13:00 and closes on 30 September 2024 at 13:00. Bidder registration is open from 9 September 2024 at 13:00 until 19 September 2024 at 23:59 on the electronic auction website https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . The goods may be inspected in person at Sliežu iela 9, Liepāja, by prior appointment with Viesturs Romanovs, Deputy Head of the Authority's Infrastructure Department, phone: 26795153, email: viesturs.romanovs@lsez.lv . The auction regulations are available on https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv and the Authority's website at https://liepaja-sez.lv/lv/parvalde/izsoles-sludinajumi . Was this information useful? text: Contact Person Viesturs Romanovs Infrastruktūras departamenta vadītāja vietnieks Phone: (+371) 26795153 Email: viesturs.romanovs@lsez.lv 01. December, 2025 Electronic Ascending-Bid Auction for the Sale of Scrap Metal The Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority (hereinafter — the Authority) is organising the disposal of its movable property — scrap metal — through an electronic ascending-bid auction. The auction starting price (reserve price) is EUR 123.08 per one (1) tonne of the goods (one hundred and twenty-three euros and eight cents), excluding value added tax. The bid increment is EUR 5.00 (five euros and zero cents). The auction security deposit is 10% of the total price of the goods — EUR 1,520.04 (one thousand five hundred and twenty euros and four cents), excluding value added tax, calculated on the basis of the approximate weight of the goods (123.5 tonnes) and the starting price per tonne (EUR 123.08). Within 10 (ten) days of the auction start date, anyone wishing to participate must transfer the deposit to the Authority, unified registration No. LV90000329402, AS “Swedbank”, account No. LV12HABA0001407037000 . The payment reference must state “Security deposit for scrap metal auction, ID No. LSEZ IZS 2025/9”. The bidder must also send a request for authorisation on the auction website https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . The auction is held on the electronic auction website https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . The auction starts on 1 December 2025 at 13:00 on https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . Applications are accepted until 11 December 2025 at 23:59 . The goods can be inspected in person and an independent assessment may be carried out by prior arrangement with Viesturs Romanovs, Deputy Head of the Authority's Infrastructure Department, telephone 26795153 , email viesturs.romanovs@lsez.lv . title: Establishment of the Karosta Canal Monitoring Network (ID No. LSEZ 2023/15)
text: Contact Person Phone: Email: 11. January, 2024 Establishment of the Karosta Canal Monitoring Network (ID No. LSEZ 2023/15) The Procurement Commission of the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority has adopted a decision on the results of the open procurement procedure “Establishment of the Karosta Canal Monitoring Network” (LSEZ 2023/15), awarding the contract to SIA “Isliena V” (registration No. 5000204363) for a total contract value of EUR 79,280.00 excluding value added tax. CPV code CPV code: 45122000-8 (Test drilling work). Project The project is implemented with co-financing from the Norwegian Financial Mechanism 2014–2021 programme “Climate Change Mitigation, Adaptation and Environment”. The subject of the contract, “Establishment of the Karosta Canal Monitoring Network at the Port of Liepāja” (hereinafter the Contract), is one of the activities of the project “Remediation of the Historically Polluted Site at Karosta Canal, Port of Liepāja” (hereinafter the Project), implemented by the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority (hereinafter the Contracting Authority). Contract performance period and location 1. Contract performance deadline: the work must be completed within three (3) months, but no later than 26 April 2024. 2. Place of performance: the work area (Figure 6.2) is Karosta Canal at the Port of Liepāja, part of the port's internal waters (cadastral Nos. 1700-010-0073 and 1700-010-0306), and an auxiliary technical site adjoining the disposal area and managed by the LSEZ Authority (cadastral No. 1700-010-0072). Procurement procedure Open procurement in accordance with the Procurement Guidelines for Public Service Providers (hereinafter the Guidelines). Available from the Procurement Monitoring Bureau (iub.gov.lv). Tenders must be submitted through the e-tendering subsystem of the Electronic Procurement System (EIS) ( https://www.eis.gov.lv/EKEIS/Supplier /) by 13 February 2024 at 10:00. Nolikums 14. title: Liepāja SEZ Authority Announces an Electronic Auction of an Audi A6 (2003)
text: Contact Person Raivo Špaks Biznesa attīstības departamenta vadītājs Phone: (+371) 29294267 Email: raivo.spaks@lsez.lv 12. December, 2023 Liepāja SEZ Authority Announces an Electronic Auction of an Audi A6 (2003) The Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority is organising the disposal of an Audi A6 vehicle (model year 2003) through an electronic ascending-bid auction. The auction takes place on the electronic auction website https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . The auction begins on 12 December 2023 at 13:00 and ends on 2 January 2024 at 13:00 . Bidder registration is open from 12 December 2023 at 13:00 until 22 December 2023 at 23:59 on the electronic auction website https://izsoles.ta.gov.lv . Prospective bidders may inspect the vehicle until 22 December 2023 , by arranging a visit in advance by telephone at 29426284 (Ainars). title: Notice of Lease Rights Auction for Property at Pulvera Street 29
text: 01. August, 2025 Notice of Lease Rights Auction for Property at Pulvera Street 29 Notice of unsuccessful auction. The Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority, unified registration No. LV90000329402, registered address Fēniksa Street 4, Liepāja, LV-3401, announces that its written auction of lease rights for the property under its management at Pulvera Street 29, Liepāja, cadastral No. 1700 010 0303, has been declared unsuccessful. The lease property consists of portions of land totalling 5,397 m² and six buildings: “Administration Building” (1700 010 0303 001), “Boiler House” (1700 010 0303 002), “Oil-Containing Wastewater Treatment Facilities” (1700 010 0303 003), “Pump House” (1700 010 0303 004), “Distribution Station” (1700 010 0303 005), and “Receiving Station” (1700 010 0303 006), together with Authority-owned engineering structures, including installations and tanks, supporting the wastewater treatment complex. ____________________________ The Authority informs that, by order of its Chief Executive dated 18 May 2026 , the deadline for approving the auction results under Clause 5.8 of the auction rules was extended to 27 May 2026 , as the next Board meeting scheduled to approve the results would take place on that date. ____________________________ The Authority clarifies the notice published on 1 August 2025 concerning the property auction at Pulvera Street 29. The notice should correctly read as follows: “Registration of bidders takes place from 1 August 2025 at 08:00 to 12 September 2025 at 16:30 . Bidders must submit their offers in person or through an authorised representative to the Authority at Fēniksa Street 4, Liepāja, by 12 September 2025, during working hours 08:00–12:00 and 12:30–16:30. Offers will be opened on 16 September 2025 at 13:00 .” The Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority (hereinafter the Authority), unified registration No. LV90000329402, registered address Fēniksa Street 4, Liepāja, LV-3401, is organising a written auction of lease rights for the property it manages at Pulvera Street 29, Liepāja (cadastral No. 1700 010 0303). The property consists of land portions totalling 5,397 m² and the following six buildings: Administration Building (1700 010 0303 001); Boiler House (1700 010 0303 002); Oil-Containing Wastewater Treatment Facilities (1700 010 0303 003); Pump House (1700 010 0303 004); Distribution Station (1700 010 0303 005); Receiving Station (1700 010 0303 006); and Authority-owned engineering structures such as installations and tanks used to operate the oil-containing wastewater treatment complex. The objective is to determine the tenant who submits the most economically advantageous offer for the lease rights and undertakes, throughout the lease term, to receive waste delivered by vessels calling at the Port of Liepāja under the vessel sanitary dues pursuant to MARPOL Annex I and to ensure its treatment in accordance with legal requirements. Initial monthly rent: EUR 2,087.00 (two thousand and eighty-seven euros and 00 cents), excluding VAT. Auction security deposit: EUR 6,000.00 (six thousand euros and 00 cents). Before submitting an application, bidders must transfer the deposit to the Authority, registration No. LV90000329402, AS “Swedbank”, account No. LV12HABA0001407037000 , with the payment reference “Security deposit for participation in the written auction of lease rights for real estate at Pulvera Street 29, Liepāja”. Participants are required to familiarise themselves with the documents relating to the leased property and its treatment facilities and inspect the property in person, agreeing on the visit time beforehand. If the bidder inspected the property during the first lease rights auction, or declines inspection for objective reasons, they must submit a signed statement with their application confirming that they inspected the property in the first auction or know and accept its condition and waive future claims concerning that condition. title: Procurement: Management of MARPOL Annex I and IV Ship-Generated Waste from Cruise Ships (LSEZ 2024/21)
text: Contact Person Phone: Email: 23. May, 2024 Procurement: Management of MARPOL Annex I and IV Ship-Generated Waste from Cruise Ships (LSEZ 2024/21) Procurement subject The procurement concerns the reception of ship-generated waste under MARPOL Annex I and MARPOL Annex IV (from cruise ships) , in accordance with the binding regulations adopted by Liepāja City Council on 22 November 2018, “Regulations of the Port of Liepāja”, the technical specification set by the contracting authority (Annex 1 to the tender regulations), the waste management plan of the Port of Liepāja, and the requirements and recommendations of Latvian legislation and international law (hereinafter — the Service). 1.1.1. Contract performance period: 48 (forty-eight) months from the conclusion of the contract. 1.4.2. Place of performance: Republic of Latvia, Liepāja, Port of Liepāja. 1.4.3. To enable suppliers to understand the scope of the procurement (the Sites), prepare high-quality tenders, calculate costs and fully assess the circumstances affecting the contract price and performance, the contracting authority requires a mandatory inspection of all Sites . The inspection time must be arranged with Maija Uzoliņa, Specialist of the Security, Defence and Environmental Department of the Liepāja SEZ Authority ( maija.uzolina@lsez.lv ; telephone 26469786 ). The Liepāja SEZ Authority will issue tenderers a certificate confirming inspection of the Port of Liepāja berths (Annex 13 to the tender regulations). 1.4.4. Only an inspection of the Sites will take place during the visit. No additional information on the subject of procurement or the tender regulations will be provided during the visit. Any further information, including answers to questions raised during visits, will be sent to all tenderers and published simultaneously in the relevant competition section of the EIS e-tender subsystem at www.eis.gov.lv as soon as possible after receipt of the questions. Answers will be provided within 5 (five) working days , but no later than 6 (six) days before the deadline for submitting tenders. 1.1.2. title: Yacht berth charges in season
text: Invest in Liepaja Port About Port Ferry traffic Cruising Liepaja Marina Oskars Kalpaks bridge Commercial Companies Development projects Job vacancies Map of territories Liepaja Marina Liepaja Marina is situated at its historic place – the canal side of the Promenade Hotel building. The location allows for yachts to be moored right in the centre of the City of Liepaja – in the vicinity to shops, restaurants, sightseeing spots, public transportation and the tourism information centre, everything within 5 to 10 minutes walking distance. The Liepaja Marina provides the yachts with all the necessary port services – moorage, water, electricity and security, garbage disposal. For the convenience of guests, showers, toilets, laundry service, as well as agent services 24 hours a day are available. Since the year 2008, Liepaja Marina has been granted the international Blue Flag eco-marking, and we are determined to retain this recognition in the years to come. The Blue Flag is a certification by the Foundation for Environmental Education, that a beach, marina or sustainable boating tourism operator meets its stringent standards. Yacht berth charges in season Lenght of the yacht ~8 m 8.01 – 10.00 m 15.01 – 20.00 m 20.01 – 30.00 m 30.01 – 50.00 m 1 day/ EUR (with VAT)* 20.00 30.00 35.00 45.00 100.00 1 month/ EUR (with VAT)** 90.00 130.00 160.00 250.00 400.00 *If the yacht / motorboat is berthed less than 24 hours, then theharbour fee calculation is made as for one full day. **Elecricity consumption is not included in monthly fee, it is calculated by the electricity meter the last day of each month. Layout of Marina berths In order to keep a watercraft at the berths of Liepaja Marina for a longer period, it is required to conclude a yacht/boat mooring agreement with the Liepaja Special Economic Zone Authority by filling out the declaration form in the Marina headquarters. The long-term mooring contracts for yachts/watercrafts alongside the Marina berths shall be concluded on a first-come, first-served basis, while the spaces allocated for this purpose are available. The berth reservation service shall not be provided. In order to apply the monthly fee tariff for long-term mooring, the minimum yacht/watercraft mooring contract duration term shall be 2 months. During the season, the vacant berths shall be provided to customers on the waiting list on a first- come, first-served basis. Regulations for Yachts and small Vessels In order to organize safe navigation, it is recommended that small ships equipped with VHF radio station constantly provide radio communications on VHF channel 11. It should be noted that any vessel traffic participant who can safely navigate outside the main shipping lanes must not obstruct the movement of vessels along them. Movement of yachts and small vessels in the harbor must be done by not disturbing the vessels sailing along the fairway. When sailing in the waters of the Port of Liepaja, one must abide by the “Regulations for the Traffic of Vessels in Internal Waters” and the “Regulations of the Port of Liepaja”. Yacht, cutters or leisure boats are considered a small vessel if unless their length does not exceeds 24 meters. Navigation for yachts and leisure boats is permitted in the City Canal. The speed limit for small vessels in the City Canal is 5 knots (9 km/h). In the rest of the harbor area, there is no speed limit, under the condition, that the speed shall not not endanger other traffic participants, people, moored vessels and other floating or stationary structures, especially considering the influence of the waves created by the particular vessel. title: Seven cruise ships and more than 4,000 visitors: Liepāja strengthens its position on the Baltic cruise map in 2026
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 4 September 2026 Seven cruise ships and more than 4,000 visitors: Liepāja strengthens its position on the Baltic cruise map in 2026 During the 2026 cruise season, Liepāja continued to strengthen its position on Baltic Sea cruise itineraries. Seven cruise ships called at the Port of Liepāja this year—the highest number ever welcomed in a single season. These visits not only create memorable experiences for residents and visitors but also make an important economic contribution to local businesses and raise Liepāja’s international profile. Interest from cruise operators remains strong for the next season: eleven calls have already been scheduled for 2027. Seven cruise ships brought 4,276 visitors to the Port of Liepāja during the 2026 season. Some passengers used shuttle buses running between the port and city centre every 30 minutes, while others joined organised tours. A total of 86 excursions took place, attended by 2,244 tourists—52.5% of all cruise passengers—demonstrating strong interest in Liepāja’s cultural, historical and tourist attractions. Following a lengthy break, cruise ship calls at Liepāja resumed in 2018 as a result of sustained efforts by the Liepāja SEZ Authority and the city to include Liepāja on international cruise routes. According to Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis, Liepāja has already established itself on the Baltic cruise map; the priority now is to build on this achievement and continue developing. Although ambitious, the city aims to welcome more than 20 cruise ships per season in the future, creating new opportunities for local businesses to develop services and experiences for visitors. Cruise passengers and crew use local transport, catering, tourism, cultural and entertainment services and visit shops, museums and other attractions. Based on estimates commonly used in the international cruise industry, each passenger spends an average of EUR 70–100 at a destination. This means the total direct economic contribution from this season’s cruise passengers to Liepāja could exceed EUR 400,000. Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis emphasises that the value of cruise tourism goes beyond its economic benefits. ‘A cruise ship in port is much more than a vessel at a berth. It gives thousands of people an opportunity to discover Liepāja—its culture, history, business environment and hospitality. Every visitor who leaves with a positive impression becomes an ambassador for our city around the world. At the same time, cruise tourism delivers real economic benefits to local businesses, increases demand for services and helps strengthen Liepāja’s competitiveness in the Baltic Sea region,’ says Hmieļevskis. Welcoming cruise ships also plays an important role in promoting the city internationally. Each call gives hundreds or even thousands of people the chance to discover Liepāja at once, helping to establish its image as a modern, welcoming and diverse destination on the Baltic Sea coast. One of Liepāja’s advantages is the port’s proximity to the city centre. Within minutes of disembarking, cruise passengers can explore the historic centre, the Great Amber Concert Hall, Karosta, Seaside Park, the beach, museums, cafés and other attractions. Some visitors choose organised tours, while others explore independently. The Liepāja SEZ Authority, Liepāja Region Tourism Information Office, and the RCA and ESTMA agencies work closely together to attract and welcome cruise ships. Cruise tourism in Liepāja is an investment not only in today’s economy but also in the city’s future, strengthening its appeal as a Baltic Sea destination. Was this information useful? title: AE Partner continues to grow and strengthen production capacity
text: 15 May 2026 AE Partner continues to grow and strengthen production capacity AE Partner Liepāja Special Economic Zone (LSEZ) SIA, a manufacturer of high-quality electrical control and monitoring equipment, ended 2025 with steady growth in both turnover and profit. In 2025, AE Partner LSEZ SIA recorded net turnover of EUR 75.6 million, up 2% year on year. It is important to note that the 2024 financial results benefited from extraordinary income related to the restructuring of the AE Partner Group, whereas the 2025 figures reflect normal business performance without such one-off items. The company's profit rose to EUR 3.6 million in 2025. Investment in expanding production in Liepāja made a significant contribution to the development of the company, which operates in Latvia and Denmark. ‘By expanding our production and office facilities by a total of 5,000 square metres, we achieved an immediate positive impact while also providing the capacity needed for further growth. We look to the future with confidence, knowing that decisions based on our strategy create a solid foundation for continued development,’ comments Morten Bitsch Janik, Chief Business Development, Finance and IT Officer of AE Partner LSEZ SIA. Profit in 2025 was also supported by dividends received from the subsidiary AE Partner DK A/S and targeted improvements in working capital management, including lower inventory levels and greater operational efficiency. With its focus on expanding and diversifying its customer portfolio, making full use of production capacity, increasing efficiency and investing in infrastructure and digital tools, AE Partner expects stable, sustainable growth in 2026 as well. About AE Partner Liepāja Special Economic Zone SIA AE Partner Liepāja Special Economic Zone SIA is a company based in Latvia and Denmark with more than 20 years of experience developing, manufacturing and servicing automation system solutions for industries including manufacturing, logistics, shipping and renewable energy. AE Partner’s main production facility is located in Liepāja. With more than 500 employees, the company is one of the region’s largest employers. Some 98% of the products and services supplied by AE Partner LSEZ SIA are exported to more than 25 countries across all continents, with Europe as its main export market. AE Partner’s operations are guided by its core values: honesty, openness, teamwork, commitment and mutual respect, reflected in its relationships with employees, customers and business partners. title: Proposals collected for new street names in Liepāja Industrial Park
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 27 May 2025 Proposals collected for new street names in Liepāja Industrial Park At the ‘Made in Liepāja’ exhibition earlier this year, the Liepāja SEZ Authority invited residents to take part in a historic initiative: proposing names for eight new streets being built on the site of the former Liepājas metalurgs steelworks. On 26 May, the exhibition results were symbolically presented at Liepāja Industrial Park, with potential locations for Martena, Trīs skursteņu, Inženieru, Eksporta, Čuguna, Naglu, Dūmu and Dzelzsgriezēja streets marked on a map. The collected proposals will be submitted to Liepāja City Municipality, which will make the final decision on the street names. From 30 January to 1 February, every visitor to the ‘Made in Liepāja’ exhibition could write down a proposed street name and pin it to a specially prepared map. In total, 385 suggestions were received, demonstrating local residents’ interest in shaping the city’s development. ‘Most respondents believed that street names should preserve something of Liepāja’s industrial history—such as Martena Street, Čuguna Street, Naglu Street and Trīs skursteņu Street. Many residents also want Liepāja to be a green, clean and sustainable city, which is why the proposed Dūmu Street gained support too—so that smoke remains only in history and in a street name,’ says Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis. A proposal by Minister for Economics Viktors Valainis to name one of the streets Eksporta Street also attracted considerable support. Exhibition participants particularly welcomed the suggestion of Dzelzsgriezēja Street, highlighting the city’s industrial heritage and its ability to transform while looking to the future. Notably, the legendary Latvian rock band Līvi began its musical journey in 1976 at the Liepājas metalurgs Palace of Culture, a place where industry and creativity came together. Long-time band member Ainars Virga attended the event, underscoring the site’s special significance for Liepāja’s cultural history. The Liepāja SEZ Authority thanks all exhibition visitors for their creativity and active participation! For information: Liepāja Industrial Park is being developed on the site of the former Liepājas metalurgs steelworks. A local spatial plan has been prepared for the area of more than 120 hectares, providing for public access and the construction of eight new streets. The Liepāja SEZ Authority and Liepāja City Municipality are developing Liepāja Industrial Park on the former steelworks site between Brīvības, Meldru, Ezermalas, Parka and Zemnieku streets. The site borders Lake Liepāja, a specially protected Natura 2000 area. Under the approved development strategy, the plan is to attract more than EUR 275 million in private investment and create at least 1,500 new jobs. Timeline: In 2018, the Ministry of Economics, Investment and Development Agency of Latvia, FeLM SIA, Liepāja City Council and Liepāja SEZ Authority signed a memorandum of intent concerning the development of the former Liepājas metalurgs site. In 2021, the development programme for the former Liepājas metalurgs site was approved, and an interinstitutional agreement on its implementation was concluded with Liepāja City Council. In 2022, the local spatial plan for the former Liepājas metalurgs site was approved. In 2022, a remediation programme was prepared for the former Liepājas metalurgs site. In 2023, the Liepāja Industrial Park (LIP) Development Strategy for 2023–2028 was approved. In 2023, several construction designs were prepared for infrastructure development works in the area. In 2023, an application for the first street construction works in Liepāja Industrial Park was prepared and submitted, and a favourable decision on funding was received. In 2023, a lease agreement was signed with Liepājas Steel SIA, valid until 31 December 2025, for the dismantling and removal of the electric steel-melting furnace. Was this information useful? title: Celebrate Sea Festival on the Water with a Rowing Competition and a Ship and Boat Parade
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 03. jūlijs, 2026 Celebrate Sea Festival on the Water with a Rowing Competition and a Ship and Boat Parade For the eighth time, the Liepāja SEZ Authority invites everyone to celebrate Sea Festival with the event “Across the City, from Lake to Sea”, taking place on 10 July in the Trade Canal near the marina. The event will open with the Seafarers’ Rowing Competition at 16:00. Participants will gather for the parade from 19:00 to 20:00, and at 20:00 the Port of Liepāja tugboats will open the parade with the sound of their horns. The promenade on the Jaunliepāja side will also be open to spectators from 16:00. The “Across the City, from Lake to Sea” event will begin with the Seafarers’ Rowing Competition. There is something new this year: to encourage those who do not consider themselves seafarers and are not familiar with rowing, a hobby category will offer a shorter, easier course where participants can experience teamwork. Experienced rowers are, of course, equally welcome. Register here: https://ej.uz/pieteikumaanketajurasbrauceji PROGRAMME: 16:00–19:00 SEAFARERS’ ROWING COMPETITION 19:00–20:00 PREPARATIONS FOR THE PARADE 20:00–21:00 SHIP AND BOAT PARADE FOR SPECTATORS GATHERING POINT – Vecā ostmala and Jaunā ostmala waterfronts opposite the marina. FOR PARTICIPANTS SEAFARERS’ ROWING COMPETITION Find like-minded people, register, practise and take part. Each team must have seven members (six rowers and one person keeping the rowing rhythm or calling commands). Registration for the competition and training sessions: https://ej.uz/pieteikumaanketajurasbrauceji SHIP AND BOAT PARADE To take part in the parade, register yourself, your team and your watercraft by 9 July. Registration: https://forms.isdev.lv/kugu-un-laivu-parade Parade assembly points: – seagoing boats by the Customs House in the Trade Canal; – lake boats in the canal between the bridges. The Liepāja SEZ Authority invites everyone to take an active part in the rowing competition and the ship and boat parade, or to come and watch. This year, the Jaunā ostmala waterfront will once again open to spectators for the event. It is planned to become a public area in the future, similar to Vecā ostmala, where port operations, ships and business activities successfully coexist with residents and tourists. title: Development of Liepāja Industrial Park Continues with Site Remediation
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 29. septembris, 2026 Development of Liepāja Industrial Park Continues with Site Remediation The Liepāja SEZ Authority continues transforming the former Liepājas metalurgs steelworks site by implementing the project “Development of the Liepāja Industrial Park Territory, Phase 2”. The project involves rehabilitating a historically contaminated industrial area and building modern infrastructure needed for business. It is being implemented under the European Union Cohesion Policy Programme for 2021–2027, supporting the transition to a climate-neutral economy and mitigating the related socioeconomic impacts in the Kurzeme region. Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis explains that the aim is to transform the former Liepājas metalurgs plant into a modern industrial park, creating space for new business initiatives. Businesses in Liepāja are growing and therefore need new sites for manufacturing and logistics projects. The industrial park will provide room for expansion and attract new investment to Liepāja. Hmieļevskis is particularly pleased that locally owned businesses see the park as a suitable location for their factories. The project will dismantle nine heavy fuel oil tanks with a combined capacity of 60,000 cubic metres and remediate soil and groundwater in the area where Eksporta Street will be built. Modern utilities, including district heating, water supply, wastewater and stormwater networks, will be installed, and Eksporta and Čuguna streets will be connected into a single road network. Construction is being carried out by A-Land SIA, under a contract signed on 28 August 2026 worth EUR 3.88 million excluding VAT. According to A-Land construction manager Dainis Kopštāls, the project presents a challenge because the site must be remediated before utilities and a section of road can be built. “Good planning by the client and the professionalism of our partners allow us to proceed on schedule.” Construction supervision is provided by Firma L4 SIA, design supervision by BM – Projekts SIA, and environmental consulting by Ameco SIA. One of the most visible elements of the project will be a new roundabout at the intersection of Eksporta and Čuguna streets. Historic slag carts will be placed at its centre to honour the area’s industrial heritage and symbolically link the history of Liepājas metalurgs with the site’s new stage of development. Sustainable thinking is embedded in the “DNA” of Liepāja Industrial Park, with education, innovation and the circular economy established as guiding principles. The former Liepājas metalurgs site is gradually being reintegrated into the city, opening it to the public and making it attractive to investors. Liepāja Industrial Park is being developed by the Liepāja SEZ Authority and Liepāja City Municipality, together with partners Liepājas ūdens SIA and Liepājas enerģija SIA, on the former Liepājas metalurgs site between Brīvības, Meldru, Ezermalas, Parka and Zemnieku streets. It borders Lake Liepāja, a specially protected Natura 2000 area. Under the approved development strategy, the plan is to attract more than EUR 275 million in private investment and create at least 1,500 new jobs. Real FDI magazine has highlighted ten of the world’s most promising industrial and logistics investment projects, naming Liepāja Industrial Park among them. In today’s competition for investment, locations that offer not only land but also modern infrastructure, energy security, logistics connections and an ecosystem suitable for advanced manufacturing are more attractive. The featured projects span several countries and development models, from major industrial centres in Germany and Spain to emerging logistics hubs in Iceland, Romania, Latvia, the United Kingdom and Mexico. For reference: In 2018, the Ministry of Economics, the Investment and Development Agency of Latvia, FeLM SIA, Liepāja City Council and the Liepāja SEZ Authority signed a memorandum of intent on developing the former Liepājas metalurgs site. In 2019, consolidation of property ownership at the former Liepājas metalurgs site began. In 2021, the development programme for the former Liepājas metalurgs site was approved, and an interinstitutional agreement was concluded with Liepāja City Council on its implementation. In 2022, the local spatial plan for the former Liepājas metalurgs site was approved. In 2022, a remediation programme for the former Liepājas metalurgs site was prepared. In 2023, the Liepāja Industrial Park (LIP) Development Strategy for 2023–2028 was approved. In 2023, several construction designs were prepared for infrastructure development at the site. In 2023, a project application for the first street construction works at LIP was prepared and submitted, and the Central Finance and Contracting Agency gave a favourable decision on the allocation of funding. In 2023, a lease agreement with Liepājas Steel SIA was signed, valid until 31 December 2025, for the dismantling and removal of the electric steelmaking furnace. In autumn 2024, construction began on the first street sections and utilities, as well as electrification of the entire site. In 2025, the disposal of existing industrial buildings began. At the end of 2025, sections of Inženieru, Eksporta, Dzelzgriezēja and Naglu streets were commissioned and opened to the public, together with utilities (water supply, wastewater, stormwater drainage and district heating networks). The project also delivered 3,865 metres of electricity supply networks and eight new transformers across the large site. In 2026, an intersection and road were built between Brīvības, Čuguna and Eksporta streets. Savings in project funding also enabled construction of an additional 289-metre section of Martena Street. In September 2026, the project “Development of the Liepāja Industrial Park Territory, Phase 2”, approved by the Central Finance and Contracting Agency, began. It includes dismantling the heavy fuel oil facilities, remediating the area and constructing road sections that connect Eksporta and Čuguna streets into a single street network. title: The Blue Flag will fly at the Liepāja SEZ Authority Marina in 2024 as well
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 31. maijs, 2024 The Blue Flag will fly at the Liepāja SEZ Authority Marina in 2024 as well The Blue Flag will fly at the Liepāja SEZ Authority Marina during the 2024 sailing and water tourism season as well. On 31 May, the flag was ceremonially raised in the presence of Karīna Tatarinova, godmother of the pilot vessel Ausma, and the management of Liepāja SEZ. The Blue Flag is an internationally recognised environmental quality ecolabel certifying that services and the environment meet more than thirty strict criteria. The marina in #Liepāja is the only marina in #Latvia to have received the Blue Flag. The unofficial opening of the yachting season is marked by the arrival of the first yacht. This year, the first yacht, the Norwegian-flagged Ada, arrived as early as 26 March. For reference: The Liepāja SEZ Authority took over management of the marina in May 2015. The marina welcomed 228 visiting yachts during the 2023 season. The marina has received the Blue Flag, a symbol of environmental and service quality, since 2008. There is also demand for marina berths from local vessel operators who provide leisure trips for tourists. Was this information useful? Yes No 16.10.2026. title: US Ambassador to Latvia Melissa Argyros: “Liepāja’s Industrial Ambitions Embody the Spirit of Latvia”
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 17. aprīlis, 2026 US Ambassador to Latvia Melissa Argyros: “Liepāja’s Industrial Ambitions Embody the Spirit of Latvia” “It is clear that Liepāja’s industrial ambitions embody the spirit of Latvia,” said US Ambassador to Latvia Melissa Argyros, who visited the Port of Liepāja and the Special Economic Zone on 16 April. Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis also introduced the ambassador to planned green energy and industrial projects brought together within the Liepāja Sustainable Industry Centre, where they complement one another. One of these projects is directly connected to the US-based global engineering technology company KBR, which will supply technology for producing sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and synthetic aviation fuel (eSAF) at the NorSAF plant. KBR recorded turnover of USD 7.8 billion last year and specialises in developing and deploying advanced technologies, building large-scale industrial facilities in many parts of the world, including the Baltic states for the first time. KBR has also carried out contracts for NASA space missions for 60 years, worth billions of dollars over time. Jānis Kisiels, Member of the Board of Liepāja SEZ company NorSAF: “We are proud to work side by side with a company as professional, experienced and successful as KBR to develop and implement the first high-tech sustainable aviation fuel project in the Baltics and the largest in Northern Europe. It is also exciting to see KBR at work every day — the company is a major NASA partner, contributing technical expertise and operational support to missions such as the Artemis programme and the James Webb Space Telescope. By using these technologies, NorSAF will strengthen Latvia’s and Europe’s energy and regional security by ensuring access to sustainable aviation fuel.” NorSAF, a Liepāja SEZ company, is developing an industrial-scale sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and synthetic aviation fuel (eSAF) production plant in the Liepāja Special Economic Zone. The plant is expected to use innovative technologies licensed from KBR, along with feedstocks including CO₂, bioethanol and green hydrogen, to produce next-generation aviation fuels in line with EU decarbonisation objectives. title: Competition Exhibition “Breath of the Sea” by Plein-Air Artists to Open
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 25. augusts, 2026 Competition Exhibition “Breath of the Sea” by Plein-Air Artists to Open Continuing a tradition spanning more than 30 years, the Liepāja SEZ Authority once again worked with artists to organise the small-scale artists’ plein-air event “Breath of the Sea”. Works created during the event will be displayed from 28 August to 10 October at the “Ludviķis” art gallery, where a competition exhibition will be held and visitors can vote for their favourite artwork. This summer, artist Aivars Kleins invited Liepāja artists and participants in previous Liepāja plein-air events from other Latvian cities to join the small-scale “Breath of the Sea” event. According to Aivars Kleins, the project aims to revive a tradition dating back 25 years: organising competition exhibitions of Liepāja artists’ works inspired by the sea and encouraging creative activity. The “Breath of the Sea” competition exhibition will open on 28 August at 16:00 in the exhibition hall of the “Ludviķis” art gallery at 3/5 Ludviķa Street, Liepāja. The exhibition at the “Ludviķis” art gallery will be on view until 10 October. Everyone is invited to visit the exhibition and take part in the visitors’ vote! Was this information useful? title: Baltic Ports Cooperate on Energy and Infrastructure Development — Liepāja SEZ Representatives Attend Meeting in Denmark
text: 27. jūnijs, 2025 Baltic Ports Cooperate on Energy and Infrastructure Development — Liepāja SEZ Representatives Attend Meeting in Denmark New technologies and opportunities in energy production are relevant to every country in the Baltic Sea region. Access to information about available funding sources and the experience of other countries in developing port infrastructure are valuable advantages for any port. One forum for sharing such experience is the meeting of members of the Baltic Ports Organization. This year’s meeting took place on 16 and 17 June at the Port of Rønne in Denmark. Liepāja SEZ was represented by Port of Liepāja Harbour Master Gints Ažēns and Egils Sveilis, Head of the Infrastructure Department at the Liepāja SEZ Authority. As Egils Sveilis noted, meetings of this kind are particularly valuable not only for learning about successful development solutions at other ports, but also for hearing about projects that did not achieve their initially expected results. When planning a new offshore wind farm support base in the Port of Liepāja, it is important to understand proven approaches early and avoid potential risks. “Cooperation with other Baltic Sea ports that have already faced similar challenges and tasks is invaluable. Only by working together can we achieve excellent results in Liepāja as well,” emphasised Egils Sveilis. Was this information useful? Yes No 16.10.2026. title: The “Liepāja District Partnership” Association Learns About Infrastructure Needed by Fishermen in the Port of Liepāja
text: 17. augusts, 2023 The “Liepāja District Partnership” Association Learns About Infrastructure Needed by Fishermen in the Port of Liepāja On 9 August, the new council of the “Liepāja District Partnership” association visited projects carried out by the Liepāja SEZ Authority in the Port of Liepāja to provide infrastructure needed by fishermen. The council also discussed needs and future initiatives with Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis and Deputy Technical Director Egils Sveilis, including projects that could be implemented under the “Fishing Ports and Landing Sites” measure of the new European Maritime and Fisheries Fund fisheries development programme. Fishing has always been important to Liepāja, encompassing not only fishing itself but also fish processing and fish product manufacturers. By improving the necessary infrastructure, the Liepāja SEZ Authority supports the industry, helps improve fishermen’s daily working conditions and at the same time enhances the urban environment for residents and visitors. Under the “Fishing Ports and Landing Sites” measure of the European Maritime and Fisheries Fund programme for 2014–2020, the Liepāja SEZ Authority implemented three projects. In 2017, it reconstructed a section of Vecā ostmala between Uliha Street and Celtnieku Street, replacing the road surface and constructing or rebuilding underground utilities. As part of the third phase, in 2019 it improved the area at the end of Uliha Street by demolishing a Soviet-era warehouse and constructing a parking area and a fish unloading facility for trucks. The largest undertaking was the second phase, commissioned in early 2023. Berths Nos. 83, 85, 86 and 87 were reconstructed on the Vecā ostmala side, while berths Nos. 71 and 72 and a section of Atslēdznieku Street were renovated on the Jaunliepāja side. In total, more than 600 metres of berths were improved: approximately 360 metres in Vecliepāja and 240 metres in Jaunliepāja. An 800-metre section of Atslēdznieku Street was also improved to support fish unloading and the movement of fishermen’s vehicles. This section of port road now has a paved surface, meaning there are no longer any shared-use dirt roads within the port area. Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis and Deputy Technical Director Egils Sveilis discussed with the council of the “Liepāja Partnership” association which projects supporting fishing and fisheries could be implemented under the European Maritime and Fisheries Fund programme for 2021–2027. The “Liepāja District Partnership” association is a local action group in South Kurzeme Municipality, founded on 19 September 2006 to promote public involvement in rural development; prepare and implement a sustainable development strategy based on community participation; foster cooperation with government, municipalities, non-governmental organisations, businesses and other institutions in Latvia and abroad; mobilise financial, material, intellectual and other resources; and represent local residents’ interests nationally and internationally. The association administers funding from the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development (EAFRD) and the European Maritime and Fisheries Fund (EMFF), supporting both business initiatives and public-benefit projects. title: Former Scrap Metal Preparation Workshop Offers Opportunities for New Business Ideas
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 10. augusts, 2026 Former Scrap Metal Preparation Workshop Offers Opportunities for New Business Ideas As work continues on the Liepāja Industrial Park at the former Liepājas metalurgs plant, the Liepāja Special Economic Zone (Liepāja SEZ) Authority has announced an auction for the former scrap metal preparation workshop at 6 Dūmu Street, Liepāja. The property being sold includes a building with an area of 25,200 m² and a land plot of approximately 46,800 m². Bidders can register on the electronic auction platform until 24 August of this year; the auction will close on 3 September at 13:00. The Liepāja SEZ Authority initially consolidated the properties on the site of the former Liepājas metalurgs plant, worked with the municipality to develop a local spatial plan and began constructing streets and utilities. Property auctions are the next step in involving businesses in the regeneration and transformation of the industrial area, offering the opportunity to acquire existing industrial buildings and renovate them to meet the needs of a modern green-economy business environment. The former Liepājas metalurgs industrial area is gradually being reintegrated into the city, making it accessible to the public and attractive to investors. The Liepāja Industrial Park is being developed by the Liepāja SEZ Authority and the Liepāja City Municipality on the site of the former Liepājas metalurgs plant, between Brīvības Street, Meldru Street, Ezermalas Street, Parka Street and Zemnieku Street in Liepāja. It borders Lake Liepāja, a specially protected NATURA 2000 nature area. Under the approved development strategy, the aim is to attract more than EUR 275 million in private investment and create at least 1,500 new jobs. Was this information useful? Jā Nē 16.10.2026. title: Caljan Doubles Production Volumes and Expands Its Team in Liepāja
text: 25. novembris, 2025 Caljan Doubles Production Volumes and Expands Its Team in Liepāja As global demand for advanced cargo-handling technology grows and the e-commerce market continues to expand steadily, conveyor and automation equipment manufacturer Caljan has doubled its production volumes. As its business grows, the company is expanding its team and recruiting production, engineering and quality assurance specialists at various levels. These market trends are driving demand for Caljan equipment from both new customers and long-standing strategic partners, including parcel carriers, postal operators, warehousing companies and retail logistics businesses. Growth is evident in Europe and the United States, where the market has recovered and resumed expansion following several months of uncertainty over tariffs. The Liepāja plant is the Caljan Group’s largest manufacturing and engineering centre worldwide, covering the entire product life cycle. Work starts with engineering design and detailed drawings and diagrams for each custom-built system, followed by metalworking, welding, assembly, testing and integration into customers’ systems. Nearly 100 new positions have been created this year, and the workforce in Liepāja is now 29% larger than in January. “Every week in Liepāja we now produce twice as many telescopic conveyors as at the beginning of the year. We maintain this pace by following one key principle: preserving the reliability, safety and durability of our equipment. That is only possible with a team that works confidently and with professional precision. The work of our specialists has helped strengthen Caljan’s position as a global market leader, producing durable equipment delivered to customers around the world,” says Gatis Dradeika, Caljan’s Managing Director in Latvia. Job Opportunities at Caljan’s Manufacturing Plant In response to the sharp increase in orders, Caljan has created several new positions and is inviting specialists to join its production, engineering and quality assurance teams. The company is recruiting electricians, assembly workers, welders, painters and warehouse staff, as well as mechanical engineers, quality engineers and quality managers. Caljan currently has approximately 30 open positions in Liepāja. “The e-commerce market is expected to maintain a steady average annual growth rate of around 6% [1] over the coming years. This means the current increase in activity is not a short-lived demand surge, and we see the growth in our workload as a stable part of the industry’s long-term development,” says Gatis Dradeika. Caljan provides employees with a modern, safe and clean working environment, competitive and fair pay, free lunches, health and accident insurance, and other benefits. About Caljan Caljan is a world-leading manufacturer of telescopic conveyors and automated loose-load handling solutions. It serves customers in Europe, North America, Asia, Africa and Australia. Caljan’s manufacturing and engineering centre in Liepāja has operated since 2006 and is now the company’s largest such facility, employing 255 people. In addition to conveyors, the site develops innovative automation solutions, and the local team actively contributes to global product development and sales support. The company’s management systems are certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 standards for quality, environmental and energy management. Was this information useful? Jā Nē 16.10.2026. title: Multipurpose Vessel “Līva” Joins the Port of Liepāja Fleet
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 12. augusts, 2026 Multipurpose Vessel “Līva” Joins the Port of Liepāja Fleet The Port of Liepāja fleet has been joined by the multipurpose vessel “Līva”, which the Liepāja SEZ Authority is leasing from LVR Flote, a subsidiary of the Freeport of Riga Authority and the only bidder to submit a tender offer. The vessel arrived at the Port of Liepāja on the morning of 12 August. It will help the Harbour Master’s Service perform its duties, including hydrographic surveys and the maintenance and replacement of aids to navigation. The deck of “Līva” can accommodate two medium-sized buoy assemblies (buoys, anchors and chains). The vessel is equipped with an auxiliary crane and is suitable for work at sea. Thanks to its ice class, the vessel can also break ice within the port’s inner waters. The Liepāja SEZ Authority is leasing the vessel alone; it will be crewed by employees of the Authority’s Harbour Master’s Service. Was this information useful? Jā Nē 16.10.2026. title: Port Cities Liepāja and Lübeck Sign Cooperation Memorandum
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 11. jūlijs, 2024 Port Cities Liepāja and Lübeck Sign Cooperation Memorandum On 11 July, during the German–Latvian Port Days, Liepāja and Lübeck signed a four-party memorandum of cooperation. It was signed by the heads of the two municipalities and representatives of the Port of Lübeck and the Liepāja SEZ Authority. The memorandum sets two principal objectives: reducing CO₂ emissions and developing infrastructure to ensure that port terminals operate efficiently, sustainably and with modern facilities in support of growing cargo flows and passenger traffic. This includes accommodating larger ships, thereby reducing CO₂ emissions per unit of cargo. “The cooperation memorandum with the city and port of Lübeck is another step towards making Liepāja an even greener, more environmentally friendly city, in line with Europe’s transition to a green economy. The maritime connection between Liepāja and Lübeck has historically been an important waterway. We are now committed to developing it as an environmentally friendly shipping corridor supporting supply chains across Europe,” says Liepāja Mayor Gunārs Ansiņš. An important part of the memorandum is an agreement to cooperate on the continued reconstruction of Berth No. 46 in the Port of Liepāja, ensuring safe mooring and ferry services for larger vessels. Reconstruction of the berth will improve the competitiveness of the Liepāja–Travemünde route and support the development of future routes. Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis stresses that both existing and future cooperation with Lübeck and its outer port of Travemünde makes it possible to set and achieve new goals. “Maritime transport is greener and friendlier to the environment and people. We are pleased that the ferry service is performing well and showing positive growth, but many trucks still travel by road. This memorandum provides for cooperation to increase ferry cargo volumes and accommodate larger vessels. We will continue working towards the successful reconstruction and development of Berth No. 46, which serves the ferry route.” The amount of cargo carried on the ferry route has increased considerably in recent years. In 2019, five years earlier, the route carried 799,449.67 tonnes of cargo, 49,296 ro-ro units and 39,987 passengers. By 2023, cargo volumes had doubled to 1,599,037.09 tonnes, while ro-ro units reached 97,419 and passenger numbers 93,777. In the first half of 2024, ro-ro cargo on the Liepāja–Travemünde ferry route also accounted for the largest increase in cargo throughput at the Port of Liepāja, at 14.16%. “The ferry terminal demonstrates how public and private investment in infrastructure development can increase cargo throughput. Just as important are timely risk management to minimise disruption to cargo flows, attracting local cargo through close cooperation between the port and manufacturing companies, and strong collaboration among businesses, the Liepāja SEZ Authority, state institutions and the municipality,” says Liepāja SEZ CEO Uldis Hmieļevskis. title: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development Leadership Learns About Liepāja’s Sustainable Industry Projects
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 12. maijs, 2026 European Bank for Reconstruction and Development Leadership Learns About Liepāja’s Sustainable Industry Projects On 11 May in London, Jānis Lapiņš, Adviser to the Liepāja SEZ CEO on renewable energy projects, together with companies involved in the Liepāja Sustainable Industry Centre initiative, presented planned projects in Liepāja to the leadership of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD). The working meeting included detailed discussions of potential financing models and cooperation with the EBRD for projects by LSEZ SIA NorSAF, SIA CIS Liepaja, and an international consortium comprising the Dutch company Van Oord and the Belgian companies Euroports and Smulders. Jānis Lapiņš briefed participants on the progress of development projects in the city of Liepāja and the Liepāja SEZ, explaining the rationale and concept behind the Liepāja Sustainable Industry Centre as well as the Liepāja Industrial Park project. The event was organised in cooperation with the EBRD, the Investment and Development Agency of Latvia (LIAA) and the Latvian Embassy in the United Kingdom. Latvia’s Ambassador to the United Kingdom, Atis Lots, also attended. Liepāja has made sustainable thinking a fundamental part of its development, consciously prioritising education, science, innovation and the principles of the circular economy. The concentration of private-sector companies in Liepāja creates unprecedented opportunities for development and greater prosperity for the city and its residents through new export-oriented industries. These sectors will make a substantial contribution to Latvia’s gross domestic product and significantly strengthen Liepāja’s economy and prospects for a better quality of life. Background The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is an international financial institution that promotes the transition to an open market economy, with a strong focus on sustainable energy and industrial development, supporting low-carbon, resource-efficient and innovative solutions. The EBRD provides financial investment, advisory services and policy reform support, primarily to the private sector, as well as selected public-sector projects in infrastructure, manufacturing, energy and trade. Its operations are founded on a distinctive political mandate: support is provided only to countries committed to democracy, pluralism and market-economy principles. The bank uses loans, equity investments and guarantees to advance sustainable industrial transformation and the energy transition. Was this information useful? Jā Nē 16.10.2026. title: “iCotton” Begins Trading Bonds on the Stock Exchange
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 23. janvāris, 2024 “iCotton” Begins Trading Bonds on the Stock Exchange Foreign investors have shown considerable interest in corporate bonds. In just a few weeks, “iCotton” raised approximately EUR 20 million through its bond issue. According to Jānis Bormanis, Deputy Chairman of the Supervisory Board of SIA “iCotton”, the proceeds have been used to repay existing loans and to enter and develop new markets. During the company’s first years of operation, approximately half of its output was sold in Russia and a smaller share in Belarus. However, even before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the company had been looking for opportunities to expand further in European markets. Trade with Russia and Belarus was discontinued in 2022. Jānis Bormanis emphasises that redirecting supply chains and finding new markets in a relatively short time was a major challenge. “In economics lectures, students are taught how to respond to a health crisis, a financial crisis, a political crisis or an energy crisis, with only a theoretical mention that these crises can coincide. In recent years, like many manufacturing companies, iCotton has had to deal with almost all of them at once. This was caused by both the COVID pandemic and the war in Ukraine, together with all their consequences. We are pleased that we succeeded.” SIA “iCotton”, the largest manufacturer of cotton hygiene products in the European Union, was founded in Liepāja in 2013. The company initially rented premises from “Lauma Fabrics”, but today it has two production buildings housing 11 production lines. For some time, SIA “iCotton” has also operated a subsidiary and a large factory in Poland; more recently it established a subsidiary in the United States to enter new markets. The company employs approximately 630 people in total and produces feminine hygiene products, dry wipes, cotton pads and other items — around 20 types of cotton hygiene products altogether. “iCotton” entering the stock exchange also serves as valuable publicity, making the company more widely known. The management of “Nasdaq Riga” hopes that other Liepāja companies may follow iCotton’s example and issue their own bonds. Was this information useful? Jā Nē 16.10.2026. title: Legislative Amendments Submitted to Extend the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Framework Until 2050
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Phone: (+371) 29233446 Email: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 21. janvāris, 2026 Legislative Amendments Submitted to Extend the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Framework Until 2050 Members of the Saeima from the United List (AS) and National Alliance (NA) have submitted amendments to the Law on the Application of Taxes in Free Ports and Special Economic Zones and the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Law to extend the Liepāja SEZ framework until 31 December 2050. Arturs Butāns (NA), Chair of the Saeima Subcommittee on Exports and Competitiveness, notes that businesses and investors look for long-term rules, predictability and investment security when making decisions. “To enable Liepāja to continue attracting new investment projects, we propose extending the SEZ’s term of operation from the currently applicable 2035 until 2050, as in the case of Rēzekne,” Butāns explains. United List (AS) members Māris Kučinskis and Edgars Putra have submitted amendments to the Law on the Application of Taxes in Free Ports and Special Economic Zones. Saeima member Edgars Putra (AS) stresses that the remaining term of the Liepāja SEZ law, which is less than ten years, naturally does not provide a sense of stability and security either for existing Liepāja SEZ companies or for potential investors. “Such a short remaining period does not allow investments to fully pay off and reduces the SEZ’s attractiveness for long-term investment. On behalf of the United List, we have prepared and submitted a proposal for the third reading of this law to extend the tax regime until 2050, ensuring a consistent regulatory framework and clear conditions for investment stability and regional competitiveness.” Was this information useful? text: For the media Photos Board meetings News O. Kalpaks Bridge to Be Closed to Traffic for Three Days During an International Film Production 16.10.2026. Read more From 16 to 24 October, Liepaja will briefly become a filming location for an international production. An adaptation of “The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo”, a novel in the globally popular “Millennium” book series, will be filmed in the city. The production company is Left Bank Pictures, known for projects such as “The Crown” and “Dept. Q”. The Oskars Kalpaks Bridge has a special role in the production, having been selected as one of the series’ main filming locations. The bridge will be closed to pedestrians and road traffic for three days during filming, and vessel traffic will also be restricted. title: Information Day Offers Visitors a Chance to Learn About the Karosta Canal Remediation Works
text: Contact person Līga Ratniece-Kadeģe Communications and Corporate Governance Specialist Tālr: (+371) 29233446 E-pasts: liga.ratniece-kadege@lsez.lv 21. aprīlis, 2023 Information Day Offers Visitors a Chance to Learn About the Karosta Canal Remediation Works On 27 April 2023, an information event will take place focusing on the cultural, historical and natural heritage of the Karosta Canal and the ongoing remediation works. Residents and visitors to Liepāja will have the opportunity to explore the canal’s history with historian Juris Raķis and observe the remediation work in progress. Visitors to the Karosta Information Day are invited to gather on 27 April at 11:00 at 2/12 Zemgales Street, by the Karosta Manege. Accompanied by historian Juris Raķis and his engaging commentary, visitors will learn about the area’s cultural, historical and natural heritage. Information materials will be presented, a short documentary about the heritage of Karosta in Liepāja and the history of the Karosta Canal will be screened, and participants will be able to walk along the canal to observe remediation activities on site. The event will conclude with a boat trip along the canal, offering a new perspective on the environmental improvement works under way. Through this information day, we invite residents and visitors to discover the history of Liepāja’s Karosta through the memories of local people and to appreciate the significance of its cultural and natural heritage over time. Karosta offers a unique insight into the history of Latvia and Liepāja. Its natural and cultural heritage, which continues to provide recreational and environmental benefits to residents, is a valuable asset deserving protection. Today, Karosta is becoming an increasingly important part of Liepāja’s social and economic life. The canal clean-up carried out under the project will therefore allow residents and tourists to enjoy Karosta in a cleaner, higher-quality environment, while supporting the recovery of aquatic ecosystems and reducing pollution. This is the third information campaign organised under the Liepāja Special Economic Zone Authority’s project “Remediation of the Historically Contaminated Site of the Karosta Canal in the Port of Liepāja”. Working together for a green Europe! The project is funded under the Norwegian Financial Mechanism 2014–2021 programme “Climate Change Mitigation, Adaptation and Environment”. Total project costs amount to EUR 5,117,647.05, of which EUR 4,350,000.00 is funding from the Norwegian Financial Mechanism. Was this information useful? Jā Nē 16.10.2026.
